headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: BEA (6)

summary: Oscar Piastri won the Chinese Grand Prix from pole position, 9.7s ahead of Lando Norris, with George Russell completing the podium.
Oliver Bearman made the biggest climb, from P17 to P8.
Yuki Tsunoda had a day to forget, dropping from P9 to P16.
The stewards penalised DOO (10 second time penalty).
There were 25 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Lando Norris leads the championship by 8 points over Max Verstappen.
